newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-Banken takes over Credit Lyonnais clearing.
newsitem.headline: S-E-Banken takes over Credit Lyonnais clearing.

text.p: Sweden's S-E-Banken said on Monday it had taken over clearing responsibilities for Credit Lyonnais in Sweden.
"This is the first time a Swedish bank has taken over responsibility for clearing for a non-Nordic bank established in Sweden," S-E-Banken said in a statement.
S-E-Banken said this would strengthen its market position while giving Credit Lyonnais a more rational and cost effective way to handle payments.
"S-E-Banken will in the long term offer its services to other overseas banks in Sweden that need to reduce their production costs through payments," the statement said.
